thread:
cheng: Heads-up — onboarding q4_0 model for tool-calls is failing our parser tests. Seen a spike in parse_error_rate on the function-calling suite (~8% -> 22%).

maria: Oof. Any reproducible example?

cheng: Pasted one sample from the eval run:```json
{
  "name": "create_ticket",
  "arguments": "{\"title\": \"OOM on batch\", \"metadata\": null}"
}
```
Note: arguments is a stringified JSON and also sometimes contains trailing commas or unescaped newlines after quantization.

samir: That looks like a q4 quantization hallucination where the model emits nested-strings instead of proper objects. Did this show up in fp16 baseline?

cheng: fp16 baseline parse_error_rate ~1.5%. q4_0 jump after quant config update. Also noticed higher entropy tokens around the argument boundary in the logits heatmap.

eval-runner: Ran targeted AB test across 2k prompts: metrics: ["parse_error_rate:22%", "strict_schema_pass:76%", "levenshtein_repair_success:10%"] — attached small CSV to bucket.

jenna: Can we try forcing deterministic decoding (greedy) for function calls and tighten max_new_tokens? That often reduces these "string-embedding" artifacts.

maria: Also try response_format enforcement (we add: "formatting:JSON_ONLY") at inference client side. But we need to measure throughput impact.

cheng: Quick patch in eval harness: switched sampling->greedy and set max_new_tokens=128, rerun: parse_error_rate dropped to 6.8% but latency decreased slightly.

devops-bot: Deploy report: canary q4_0 -> 10% traffic, route fallback to fp16 on parse failure enabled.

samir: Long-term we should add a lightweight pre-parse sanitizer: if arguments looks like a string, attempt JSON.parse; if fails, run a small regex-based cleanup (fix trailing commas, unescape newlines) before passing to tool layer. But that's brittle.

maria: Agreed. Also need onboarding gate: require strict_schema_pass >= 95% on the function-calling corpus, plus regression test against critical prompts with golden outputs.

cheng: Plan: 1) run q4_0 with greedy + response_format enforcement across full suite, 2) add sanitizer + fallback to fp16, 3) add rollout gate and collect production parse_error_rate. I'll open a PR with the harness changes.

jenna: Please tag me on the PR — I'll run perf tradeoff numbers.

samir: One more experiment idea: try q4_K_median (diff quant library) — some kernels handle string tokens better. Worth a short run.

cheng: Noted. Will include q4_K_median and int8 in the experimental matrix. Thanks everyone.

(End of thread)
